name: Advanced International Multitech Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced International Multitech Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of golf equipment, golf ball, and composite materials in the Americas, Asia, and internationally. It offers thermoset and thermoplastic composites; carbon fiber wheels; driver heads, iron heads, putters, and carbon fiber clubs; aircraft interior, automotive parts; electronic product parts, including laptop carbon fiber cover and tablet protector; industrial products, including robot arm accessories, tubular support frame, and assistive devices; and interior components, bicycle parts, and industrial hardware components, as well as technical services.
